title: [BUG] ASSIGNED_SF DIO option (0x14) is never emitted; gateway least-loaded tracker is dead code (spec 02 3.4)
description: Req R-02-016: Nodes MUST use assigned SF for all TX after joining. DIVERGENT: codec and C RX parse are wired but no implementation ever emits the option, so assignment can never arrive. Evidence: rust/lichen-core/src/constants.rs:66 DIO_OPTION_ASSIGNED_SF=0x14, sf_assignment.rs:149-247 make/parse/GatewaySfTracker (tracker has zero production callers); C rpl_messages.h:70, rpl_sf_assignment.c:22-40, dodag.c:667-674 parses and pushes to lora_l2_assign_sf -> TX datarate (lora_l2.c:231-244,308) — C consume side works, emit side absent; python link/sf_assignment.py. make_assigned_sf_option called only from tests. Suggested placement: border-router DIO construction (rust/lichen-rpl or lichen-gateway DIO builder; C lichen/apps/gateway + rpl dodag DIO TX), gateway per-SF node tracking wired to GatewaySfTracker/lichen_rpl tracker, plus join-response path per spec.
close_reason: Re-close: the ASSIGNED_SF DIO emit was landed in commit ad4a78be72 (rpl_root.c + rpl_messages.{h,c}) and is on beads-worker-2. Store churn reverted the close. The emit side is complete; the consume side (dodag.c 0x14 parse + lora_l2_assign_sf) was landed in b7z9.30.1. Both sides are wired. Remaining: the Rust emit path (sf_assignment.rs GatewaySfTracker wiring) is tracked by sibling 4k15 (released with scoping notes).
